verdicts.line: Practise on the empty stage · Sit in the empty seats · Sit at the back of drama · Sit in on the rehearsal
verdicts.why: Every open hour has something to do alone. Cross away (Mon/Wed, Tue/Thu 9-11 and 13-21, Fri 9-14 and 18-21): Practise and Sit in the empty seats, 2 a day each. Tue/Thu 11-13: the back row, met or unmet (clears P04r10-c1). Tue/Thu/Fri 14-18: the rehearsal. After all four capped uses in a day the menu is empty while Cross is away, the same as every capped row that hides once used (clock.md rule 10, LO's 11-24 call); clears P04r10-c2.
